title: Bechorot daf 59

chapters.title: Rava's ruling on the tenth animal
The status of the ninth animal and Rabbi Shimon ben Yehudah

summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through the discussion in Masekhet Bechorot about the laws of animal tithes, specifically examining whether the tenth animal becomes automatically holy without speech or pointing when a pen contains exactly ten animals. He also analyzes Rashi and various baraitot regarding counting mistakes, the status of the ninth and eleventh animals, and when a potential quorum (minyan ra'oi) exempts other animals.
questions: Does the tenth animal become holy automatically without speech or pointing when there are exactly ten animals in the pen?
What is the status of the ninth animal if a mistake is made in the count?
Under what circumstances does a minyan ra'oi exempt other animals from maaser?
How do multiple doorways affect the counting and exemption of animals?
